# India Selection

> Editorial curation platform of Indian consumer-goods brands — home appliances, consumer electronics/3C, bedding & mattresses, home & kitchenware, packaged food and insulated drinkware — with rankings, brand profiles, key facts and sourcing notes for global buyers.

## Categories

- [All categories](https://www.india-selection.com/categories.html): hub of every category we track
- [Home Appliances](https://www.india-selection.com/cat-appliances.html): Mixers, fans, washing machines and the kitchen-electrical names Indian homes trust. (6 brands, 3 rankings)
- [Consumer Electronics / 3C](https://www.india-selection.com/cat-electronics.html): TWS earbuds, smartwatches and budget smartphones — where Indian D2C brands now lead. (6 brands, 3 rankings)
- [Bedding & Mattresses](https://www.india-selection.com/cat-bedding.html): Mattresses and bedsheets — from legacy coir names to D2C sleep-tech brands. (6 brands, 2 rankings)
- [Home & Kitchenware](https://www.india-selection.com/cat-homeware.html): Pressure cookers, cookware and storage — the everyday Indian kitchen names. (6 brands, 3 rankings)
- [Packaged Food](https://www.india-selection.com/cat-packaged-food.html): Chocolates, instant noodles, candy, biscuits, snacks and tea — the Indian packaged-food brands households reach for. (20 brands, 6 rankings)
- [Insulated drinkware](https://www.india-selection.com/brands.html): our original library of drinkware brands
